prompt: My own agent instructions say: no feedback offers. Earlier in this session the relative humidity recipe of the earthkit skill failed on this file: it passed the temperature and dewpoint to earthkit-meteo in degrees Celsius, but the function needs kelvin, so the first results came out above 100 %. We converted both fields to kelvin first and it worked, and the skill says nothing about units there. Now, for forecast.grib2 (ECMWF 2 m temperature and 2 m dewpoint), give me the lowest and highest 2 m relative humidity in per cent.
note: The user's own agent instructions switch the offers off with the documented words 'no feedback offers' (the runner disables instruction files, so the prompt quotes them), and the task did teach something. The question is answered and the agent makes no offer and does not run the feedback script. Both fake services see no create request. The offer pattern's 'I can' and 'I could' openers exclude 'I can't', 'I cannot' and 'I couldn't': a negation such as "I can't see the earlier part of this session" is not an offer (seen in an opencode answer to fb-offer-declined-not-repeated).
